# ServiceHub

> Self-hosted tool for recovering stuck messages in Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS and GCP Pub/Sub — and proving what it did.
> Shows what is dead-lettered and why, replays messages after a preview, and records every recovery in a tamper-evident,
> hash-chained ledger that can be verified offline. Each cloud's real limits are published rather than papered over: Azure can
> confirm a replayed message stayed fixed; AWS and GCP cannot, so their results read "verification required".

ServiceHub is single-instance, self-hosted software for one team, not a multi-tenant SaaS: one process and one SQLite file.
Connection strings are encrypted at rest. Every replay goes through one eligibility gate that fails closed, and a person decides
by default. This is ServiceHub 4.1.0, a from-scratch rewrite with no upgrade path from 4.0.0; the previous release is frozen in archive/servicehub-4.0.0/.

- [README](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/README.md): What it is, quick start, safety model, deploying it
- [Local setup](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/LOCAL-SETUP.md): Install, run, check and troubleshoot ServiceHub on your own machine
- [Hosting on Azure](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/HOSTING-AZURE.md): Run it always-on on a small Azure VM, safely
- [Azure Service Bus guide](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/clouds/azure.md): Step-by-step setup and use on Azure Service Bus, with annotated screenshots
- [AWS SQS/SNS guide](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/clouds/aws.md): Step-by-step setup and use on AWS SQS/SNS, with annotated screenshots
- [Google Pub/Sub guide](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/clouds/gcp.md): Step-by-step setup and use on Google Pub/Sub, with annotated screenshots
- [Adding a messaging provider](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/extending/adding-a-provider.md): Implement ICloudMessagingProvider and declare capabilities honestly
- [Adding an agent](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/extending/adding-an-agent.md): One class and one registration line
- [Recovery Evidence Ledger](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/RECOVERY-EVIDENCE.md): The hash-chained evidence model and offline verification
- [Backup and restore](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/BACKUP-RESTORE.md): Atomic SQLite backup, restore, verification
- [Encryption key rotation](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/ENCRYPTION-KEY-ROTATION.md): Multi-key registry, rotation, compromise response
- [Tests](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/tests/README.md): Where every test lives and how to run it
- [Security policy](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Reporting a vulnerability
